P6.quantity: pooled within-set correlation of the registered temperature on odd and on even cycles

P2.quantity: pooled s_w and its 95 % interval, per K

P3.quantity: temperature's lever with ln R held, against s_w over the same cells, per K

P4.quantity: pooled s_b and its 95 % interval, per K

P5.quantity: s_b - s_w and its 95 % interval, per K

P7.quantity: pooled s_w against Sandia's 25 to 35 C 2C interval, per K
